description: This file defines the custom exception class 'DittoHeaderInvalidException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It models an error condition when an external header value cannot be converted to a valid Ditto header, including multiple builder methods for constructing exceptions with different contexts.

classes.name: DittoHeaderInvalidException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a header value is invalid in the context of Eclipse Ditto, providing multiple static builder methods to create instances with specific error information.

classes.name: DittoHeaderInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of DittoHeaderInvalidException with fluent API, supporting different initialization scenarios such as invalid type or custom message.

methods.name: newInvalidTypeBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for an invalid header type error, accepting header name, value, and expected type.

methods.name: newInvalidTypeBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for an invalid header type error from a HeaderDefinition object, header value, and expected type.

methods.name: newCustomMessageBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder with a custom error message.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an instance of DittoHeaderInvalidException from a JSON object, reporting specific error details.
